external_theorem.paper: Beame, Impagliazzo, Pitassi, Segerlind — Formula Caching in DPLL, ACM TOCT 2010
external_theorem.source_lower_bound: Theorem 4.28: every FCWS refutation of GT_n requires at least 2^(n-2) nodes; proof identifies 2^(n-2) distinct residual formulas at novelty level n-2

construction.family: H_n = GT_n AND BOOST_n AND RESOLUTION_SINK_n
construction.variable_order_constraint: d has the smallest variable id

proved_mechanics.sink_resolvent: (a OR u_r OR ~a OR v_s) = TAUTOLOGY
proved_mechanics.reason_core_not_reached: the attempt budget is exhausted inside the first pivot d
proved_mechanics.branch_selection: while a core variable remains, Policy-0A must branch on a GT-core variable
proved_mechanics.projection: delete clauses containing padding variables; the resulting residual equals unitprop(GT_n restricted by the accumulated core assignment)
proved_mechanics.cache_collision_rule: equal augmented keys imply equal projected core residuals

asymptotic_transfer.projected_system: exact Formula Caching on theorem-matched GT_n
asymptotic_transfer.conclusion: 2^(n-2) is superpolynomial in N_n; therefore no fixed c can satisfy S(F)<=N^c for every CNF if the implementation-parity gates pass
